prompt: In Kruskal's algorithm for finding a Minimum Spanning Tree of a connected weighted graph with V vertices and E edges, what dominates the time complexity?
options: Checking tree connectivity in O(V + E)
Finding disjoint set components in O(V²)
Inserting edges into an adjacency list in O(V)
Sorting the edges in O(E log E) time
explanation: Kruskal's algorithm sorts all edges by weight, taking O(E log E) = O(E log V) time. Subsequent DSU find/union operations take nearly linear O(E α(V)) time, so edge sorting dominates.
